tool.title: Keep a note on the work
tool.description: Keep a short note on the work you are doing — what you did, what you decided and why, and what is left open — so it is there when the work is picked up again.

inputs.name: note
inputs.description: The note, in plain words. One paragraph is plenty.

$comment.comment: Its own Tool, outside the sdlc sub-graph, so a run can offer it to an agent told nothing about the work plan (owner, 2026-11-03, cat-harness#991 Q11, proposal §4.13: "would an agent still see it through dependency tree... in that case it needs to be own tool"). Everything the agent reads here is neutral on purpose; check:context-leak scans it. The backend wraps the note with its metadata and keeps it on the run's work item through the deployment's stores["work-context"] (cat-harness-tools#1435).
